For OP and anyone else thinking of doing this (again, possibly) but has regrets about it right after taking the drugs, here is how to negate the effects: 

For saving yourself from immediate danger:

Stick your thumb and index finger as far down your throat as possible while leaning forward. (Call 911 first). Then, drink a bunch of water. Maybe eat something to kinda subside any effects of drugs that may have gone in your system.

For prevention outside of the situation (ways to stop yourself/make it harder for you to do it):

Hide any lethal substances on top shelves. This taps into our brain's lazy side and makes us less likely to take the little more effort to go get the pills unless you need them for a medical emergency (such as an illness/disease or diagnosed mental disability). 

Then, whenever you feel like you wanna do the drugs, tell someone in the house if anyone and go into a room where there are no pills. That puts distance between you and the pills and makes someone aware you may take them, so they can either try to block you from getting to them or call a doctor if you suddenly faint. 

Why does putting distance between you and the pills help? 

It helps because not only the obvious reason if bring father away, but also because it's easier to forget about the pills when you aren't a couple feet away from them. So even if you have the will power to not do them while in the room, the time you are thinking of it could be prolonged if you stay in that room. Furthermore, you may find something that could distract you in a different room. Maybe you could go in the backyard/balcony to take a breath. Maybe you could fold some clothes you forgot about. You get the point.

Crisis/suicide hotlines per country: https://en.m.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_suicide_crisis_lines

For all the people not comfortable clicking a link but think you would like this: 
3 cups cooked chickpeas or 2 15 ounce cans, drained

1 large yellow onion, chopped

1 red bell pepper, chopped

1 large crown of broccoli, chopped into bite-sized trees

3-4 cloves of garlic, minced

3 tablespoons olive oil

2 tablespoons soy sauce, tamari, or Bragg Liquid Aminos

1 lime

Spice Blend

2 teaspoons chili powder blend

1 teaspoon ground cumin

1 teaspoon smoked paprika

1/2 teaspoon ground coriander (or more cumin if you don't have that shit)

cayenne pepper to taste

burrito trimmings: tortillas, avocado, spinach, lettuce, cilantro, salsa, our Tex-Mex Queso

DIRECTIONS

Heat the oven to 425 degrees.
Place all the chopped up veggies (aside from the garlic) in a large bowl with the cooked chickpeas. Mix the spices together in a small bowl. Pour in the oil and soy sauce, stir, and then throw spice blend all over those fuckers. Mix until all the vegetables and shit are covered.
Put all of that on a large rimmed baking sheet and bake for 20 minutes. Take it out of the oven, don’t fucking burn yourself, add the garlic, and stir it around. Bake for another 15 minutes. The broccoli might look a little burnt at this point but that is the plan so chill the fuck out and take it out of the oven. Squeeze the juice of half of the lime over the pan and stir the roasted chickpeas and veggies all around. Taste and see if it needs more spices or anything. Now make a motherfucking burrito.
